issue.title: Digest-pinned trust for project-local commands
issue.description: Require human acknowledgment of a project's current executable config before host-side hooks or config-defined workflows can run, while preserving ordinary local configuration.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/local_config_digest_trust.md requests this work

issue.title: Define the Rust local-command trust contract
issue.description:
trust-policy: Implement the pure Rust command-bearing projection, canonical
digest, filtering and trust-decision contracts described in this plan. Add
PyO3 bindings, round-trip tests and a thin Python adapter. Cover normalized
legacy macro spellings, partial overrides of executable definitions, file
hook template references, nested workflow steps and unchanged non-command
keys. Do not activate enforcement yet. Publish core changes through host
finalization and ensure the sase core revision pin contains the bindings.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/local_config_digest_trust.md defines phase trust-policy as one work unit

issue.title: Persist trust and add human acknowledgment commands
issue.description:
trust-approval: Implement the Rust-owned machine-local trust store and the
thin Python project-identity and filesystem adapters. Add sase config trust
allow/status/revoke with the human-only acknowledgment contract in this plan.
Trust must bind the reviewed digest to a host-resolved project identity;
reject stale approvals and all agent/monitor acknowledgment attempts. Add
atomicity, identity, failure and CLI tests. Document the trust commands and
store. This phase does not yet change runtime command loading.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/local_config_digest_trust.md defines phase trust-approval as one work unit

issue.title: Enforce trust for merged config and file hooks
issue.description:
hook-enforcement: Create the mandatory local_config_command_trust sunset
flag using sase flag new, then filter local executable contributions before
merging and before the independent file-hook loader consumes raw layers.
Wire fresh trust checks into before/after commit hooks, explicit-project
rebase gates and file-hook execution. Keep raw inspection and feature-flag
bootstrap separate from runtime filtering. Preserve user/overlay commands,
non-command local values and the explicit flag-Off compatibility branch.
Add both-state and stale-cache/end-to-end no-execution regressions.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/local_config_digest_trust.md defines phase hook-enforcement as one work unit

issue.title: Enforce trust for local macro workflows and finish integration
issue.description:
macro-enforcement: Apply the shared policy to config macro sources and the
direct load_project_local_macros path, preserve provenance through parsing
and namespacing, and revalidate executable local definitions before their
bash/python steps run. Cover nested steps, references, inherited executable
definitions, revocation and content changes. Finish runtime diagnostics,
migration docs and the combined acceptance matrix. Run the required checks
and leave completion evidence for this child epic's land agent; do not close
sase-1sb.2 or any ancestor from a child phase.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/local_config_digest_trust.md defines phase macro-enforcement as one work unit

payload.entry:
LANDING AUDIT: NOT READY TO CLOSE. Read epic (no prior own notes), all four child beads and every child note, approved plan, all five sase epic commits 2e7ce5cea1/181b213e8c/7710dd0bc6/021cd73021/ea4121387b, and core e7647bf7/233cb41d. Inspected Rust classifier/digest/store/bindings and Python identity/CLI/loaders/execution boundaries. Pin 233cb41d6bb7186a711e75999394570e9ad9943e contains required exports. Digest-trust decision, human acknowledgment, and default-On sunset flag are implemented, but runtime acceptance is incomplete.

Independent verification: four trust suites together = 51 passed in 8.54s. No check-full. Safe deterministic probes in file:explicit:f7ff68994727a64108f4cdd2 demonstrate: (1) ordinary macro loader attaches approved snapshot B's descriptor to retained code A; (2) revoke between rebase merged-load and reevaluation yields retained local command with trust=None and reaches mocked execute_gate; (3) explicitly local file-hook run without descriptor is allowed; (4) Off-loaded workflow passes script guard after flag becomes On without approval; (5) revoked local embedded pre-step executes a temporary sentinel through a user-origin parent, while the direct child check correctly blocks; (6) merged config cache returns the same revoked command mapping after revoke; (7) acknowledged sparse local input override is discarded and returns user default/source without local provenance. File-hook dispatch also rereads ambient config instead of carrying original hook trust; loader evaluation exceptions fail open. These are remaining epic work, not task follow-ups.

Integration: fetched origin, HEAD=origin/master=ea4121387b. Non-child commits since first trust commit are d0dc942c16 (sibling prompt provenance) and 1e4bcb5f38 (docs refresh); reviewed shared embedded/rendering paths and docs. Preserve their safeguards while repairing snapshot propagation; no core drift after the two core epic commits. Required full landing checks will follow repairs.

Symbol readiness: epic-symbols lists six ROOT-epic entries despite phase-local empty reports: LocalCommandDigest, LocalCommandTrustError, LocalTrustDecision, LocalTrustFilterResult, digest_local_commands, local_command_trust_wire_schema_version. Planned disposition: privatize the three in-module-only classes; delete unused Python digest wrapper/return type and version wrapper, retaining consumed projection/direct Rust wire tests and Rust ABI; remove six Justfile exemptions.

FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE COMPLETE: the sole proposal, .3 note #1 edit-lock concurrency flake, was searched across all-status tasks and recent tasks and checked against active epic scope. Deterministically reproduced two owners from an empty-lock publication window in .5's code; recorded DISCOVERED ISSUE on causal active parent epic sase-1sb with the evidence ref. No duplicate/new task; declined quarantine/retry because this is a real ownership race. No other child proposals. Proposing one medium tale to fix the bounded trust integration gaps, rerun checks, clean symbols, close this epic normally, mark plan:202611/local_config_digest_trust.md done, and close only delegated parent phase sase-1sb.2. Do not close containing epic sase-1sb.
